correctness.rationale: For odd n=2q+1>=5, reflection j→2-j fixes precisely j=1 and splits the unweighted one-chord Laplacian into cosine-even and q-dimensional odd Jacobi sectors. Even eigenvalues 2-2cos(2πk/n) are simple, and cos(2πk(j-1)/n) is nonzero at integer j since a zero would equate an even integer to an odd n multiple. The chord is a positive rank-one update in the odd sector; strict interlacing disjoins the even/odd eigenvalues. The odd Jacobi block with diagonal (4,2,...,2,3) has all eigenvector coordinates nonzero: an interior zero would force a shared leading/trailing block eigenvalue; the Chebyshev recurrence and reduction of its cyclotomic equation modulo 2 produce the odd-order contradiction z^2=1. PBH therefore holds at every j≠1; odd reflection modes vanish at j=1. No singleton is zero forcing because every degree is at least two. Independently assembled Laplacians and modular Krylov ranks for n=5,7,9,11: every j≠1 full rank n; j=1 ranks (n+1)/2. Nonzero minors over a finite field imply rational controllability; the all-n necessity comes from reflection, not incomplete finite-field ranks.
